Text: Freya turned a vague growth goal into a product roadmap with clear bets, and then killed two of them when the A/B tests said so. Engineering always knew why a feature mattered.
Kestrel closed our first three enterprise sales contracts and built the reseller partnership programme from nothing. Negotiations stayed friendly even when the procurement teams did not.
Zoë rewrote our API documentation and quickstart guides. Support tickets about authentication fell sharply, and new developers now reach a first successful request in minutes.

Marlow rebuilt our engineering hiring loop with structured interviews and a fair take-home exercise.

Time to hire halved and candidates told us the recruiting process was the reason they accepted.
Juno wrote the firmware for our sensor boards and tracked down a power regression with an oscilloscope and a great deal of patience. Battery life doubled after the RTOS scheduling fix.
